Boats include deck boats, pontoons, slide boats, center consoles, and mini speed boats. Multi-day rentals and private charters are available for customized boating experiences.

quotes.author: Edie Lang
quotes.text: Great fun!! We really enjoyed our charter! Tammy was amazing setting it up for us and our captain Ian was great!! Highly recommend getting the fish and shrimp tacos for the trip!

quotes.author: Mark Kilduff
quotes.text: The owners and staff were very friendly and knowledgeable. Equipment was in good working order , and gave us good instruction, so that we had a fun and safe adventure.

quotes.author: Steph R
quotes.text: Thank You! We had the best time renting a pontoon boat for our family! The process was easy and made our trip extra memorable! We will be back soon!!

quotes.author: Kevin Valentine
quotes.text: Solid service great instructions mixed with a great sense of humor. It was cold that day but we had a good time!!
